posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
OK, I have always wondered about the HOE in a LCD panel. I gather it is a holographic diffuser? 

My daughter sucked on my cell phone till the diffuser had a mottled pattern in it, it has taken months to dry back to the original pattern. What material are they made from? Bob, Ed? Have you guys made any of these?

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md:
Is the diffuser holographic? Check it out when the phone dies by taking it out and running an undiverged beam through it.

I am guessing that the material is a UV curable on a plastic substrate. It may have looked mottled for a while until the spittle dried off, which was index matching out the surface relief.

A site that I know that makes these kinds of things is Wavefront, wft.bz.
